body: I think the current implementation is fine. Checking for `[` ensures that expensive BBCode parsing is done only if there can be BBCode. Most messages won't be affected and checking for a single char is cheap compared to searching for match.

Could you squash your commits? See our [pull request guidelines](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/organization/pull_requests/creating_pull_requests.html#the-interactive-rebase) for more information
Thanks! Congratulations on your first merged contribution! 🎉
